en: A black‑and‑white view of a lakeside or riverside promenade with many wooden tables and folding chairs arranged like an outdoor café or beer garden. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing sit or stand by the tables, including men in suits and hats. Dense shrubs line a fence that separates the seating area from the water. On the calm water, small rowboats and one person in a boat are visible, with forested hills rising in the background. There is no visible printed caption or text on the image side.
